content: CanIf shall provide wake-up service CanIf_CheckWakeup () only, if • underlying CAN Controller provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfCtrlWakeupSupport and by CanDrv configuration. • and/or underlying CAN Transceiver provides wake-up support and wake-up is enabled by the parameter CanIfTrcvWakeupSupport and by CanTrcv con- figuration. • and configuration parameter CanIfWakeupSupport is enabled.
